name: talks-over-most-of-disclosure
about: Somebody talks over more than half of the disclosure. It cannot be interrupted, and a disclosure that was mostly talked over was not really heard, so the gate plays it once more before anything else. The transcript records the replay as a system line, never as a second thing the agent said.
turns: Hello? Hello, who is this? Sorry, it is very loud in here tonight, the dinner rush has just started and I can barely hear a thing on this line, can you say that again?

audio.about: Turn 0 starts 200ms into the disclosure and runs past its end, so more than half of it is talked over and it is replayed once. Only `npm run call` reads this block; the text harness ignores it.
